title: 36 Hours in Hyderabad, India
abstract: As this high-tech capital marches steadily into the future, visitors should not forget the city’s regal past — nor its celebrated culinary offerings.

title: 36 Hours in Tangier
abstract: The Moroccan port city that lured Paul Bowles and Jean Genet is in turnaround mode, but its classic draws — iconic cafes, long beaches — remain.

title: 36 Hours on the Amalfi Coast
abstract: Seek out the less-heralded towns on this 30-mile stretch of Italian coast, and discover the untrammeled charm that drew the likes of John Steinbeck.

title: 36 Hours in Louisville
abstract: Brandy distilleries, “hot” chicken, cool shops and theater: There’s more to Louisville than horse racing and bourbon.
